description: This file defines the ExecutorPlugin interface for Spark, including lifecycle methods for initialization, shutdown, and task event handling, used as part of Spark plugin development.

classes.name: ExecutorPlugin
classes.description: Interface for Spark executor plugins, providing lifecycle and task event methods.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the executor plugin during executor startup, allowing registration of metrics.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Cleans up resources during executor shutdown.

methods.name: onTaskStart
methods.description: Performs actions before a task starts; called from the task thread.

methods.name: onTaskSucceeded
methods.description: Performs actions after a task completes successfully.

methods.name: onTaskFailed
methods.description: Performs actions after a task fails, receiving the failure reason.
